name: Quiet Garden
description: A gentle walk through an imaginary garden, with soft music. About five minutes.

cues.text: Picture a quiet garden in the early light.
Notice the colors: soft greens, a few pale flowers.
Listen for small sounds. A bee. A leaf.
Walk slowly along the path in your mind.
Find a bench and sit for a while.
When you are ready, let the garden fade gently.
